implementation_summary: share-api.ts: createPreview (POST AUDIT_API.createPreview with {version, language}), previewUrl (GET /api/audits/:id/preview?version=n), listSharedLinks, createSharedLink, revokeSharedLink, revokeAfterConfirm (sends nothing when cancelled), and helpers sharedLinkAddress (origin + /s/ + id), linkState (open/expired/revoked), expiryText (SHARE_LINK_DAYS), withLink. Refusal codes become plain sentences; ERR_NO_AI_KEY becomes NO_AI_KEY_MESSAGE. PreviewShareScreen.tsx: stateless PreviewShareView plus stateful PreviewShareScreen, which loads the finished versions (saved-api loadVersion) and the Shared Links. It has a version select; a preview panel with a language select, 'Make preview', and an 'Open preview' link (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer); a Notice with a Link to PATHS.settings on ERR_NO_AI_KEY; a Make Shared Link panel (kind radios, language select) that shows the full link in a read-only labelled input with a 'Copy Shared Link' button, the expiry date (30 days) and a warn Notice that anyone holding the link can open it; and a Shared Links table (kind, version, language, created, expires, state) with Revoke buttons named by aria-label, confirmed through useConfirm before the DELETE. Loading, empty, failed and no-finished-version states are handled. Follows the HelpersScreen and helper-api conventions.

risks: Router wiring for AUDIT_PATHS.previewShare is not in this task's ownership; the wizard router must show PreviewShareScreen there (props: auditId, optional version).
Assumes the revoke reply is ShareLinkReply ({ link }), as declared in the types file; a different runner reply shows 'could not be revoked' even though the revoke worked.
Language choice is limited to English and Tamil (glossary and export panel), though DocumentLanguage allows 12.
'Open preview' is always shown; with no preview made yet, the runner's answer appears in the new tab.
Expiry and created dates use an English date format regardless of the link's language.
The test file is not covered by the type-check, which includes src only.
handoff: Wire PreviewShareScreen into the wizard router at AUDIT_PATHS.previewShare(auditId). share-api exports NO_AI_KEY_MESSAGE, SHARED_LINK_WARNING, KIND_LABEL and SHARE_LANGUAGES for reuse. The confirmation-before-revoke logic is in revokeAfterConfirm and is unit-tested.
